title: ucw-dream
label: Jarrell Young

won.source: PWE's own Deadly Game results of 27 November 2005, which bill him as the defending champion (PWE's own Deadly Game results of 27 November 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/front-page-news-2005-12-05.html))

note: The win that started this reign is not in the record; the defence is — a cage of weapons against Eric Flowers, Leviathon and Trey Deep, retained by pinfall. The defence is now structured as a match on the show that staged it.

title: ucw-heavyweight
label: Trent Hawk

won.source: The Mask's own account of the promotion's last night (the fed's own invasion promo, delivered on PWE Underground in October 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/mortis-v-the-mask-2005-10-10.html)), and the fed's own A Belated ‘Sacrifice’, which has him arrive with the belt in August 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/a-belated-sacrifice-2005-08-17.html)

note: Neither cited document dates the win: the August document calls the belt “the UCW championship” and shows it taken off him at a door, and the October promo supplies the name “Heavyweight Title” and the fact that it was still his when the promotion announced the unification match. The reign has no recorded start and no recorded end.

title: ucw-us
label: Mike Smith

won.source: the character's own career ledger, carried in his signature on the board's own member profile — held in the workshop and not served, this wing's member profiles being withheld whole

how: Beats The Mask in a US Title match.
note: The ledger records the match and not the reign: “Loses to Mike Smith in US Title match”, with no “Won” line under it — the line the same ledger writes under both of the title matches its subject actually won. Mike Smith is recorded as holder because he is the man the ledger has winning a match for that championship; whether he was defending it or taking it that night is not in the record, and neither is any date.
